name: Alicia Campos Masso
abstract_title: Memory as Inheritance: Reframing Reincarnation Studies through the Möbius Soul in the Philosophy of Consciousness
abstract: Why interpret so‑called past‑life memories as literal reincarnation? Why not as fragments of collective memory, cultural archetypes, or narrative consciousness instead of returning to frameworks of punishment, rebirth, and moral accounting? Religious traditions such as Hinduism and Buddhism have long embraced reincarnation, articulated through karma and samsara, in which the soul undergoes cycles of rebirth shaped by moral causality.
